create_budget_create_user_budget: create a budget for a user with total_budget, optional duration like daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly
update_cost_track_usage_cost: update and track the cost of a user's API usage by model with token counts or a completion response object
projected_cost_estimate_future_cost: project the cost of a model call given messages and a user to check if it exceeds their budget
reset_cost_reset_user_spending: reset a user's current cost and model_cost tracking to zero
reset_on_duration_reset_periodic_budget: reset a user's cost when their time duration (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) has elapsed
